title: Wrong assumption that the input token will be WETH
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  ULTI accepts any ERC20 token as the input token and in the constructor, the input token number of decimals is stored in the `inputTokenDecimals` variable.  ```solidity 219:     /// @notice Address of the input token (e.g. WETH, DAI, etc.) 220:     address public immutable inputTokenAddress;     (...) 451:         inputTokenDecimals = IERC20(_inputTokenAddress).decimals(); ```  However, this value is never used and some constants and calculations are based on the assumption that the input token will be WETH, using the expected
